entities.name: Leandro Müller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leandro Müller is a Brazilian writer. He has a double degree in Journalism and Advertising from the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro. Muller studied Philosophy at the State University of Rio de Janeiro and at Porto University. He has been writing since 2004. He also worked as an editor in publishing.
